tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal rdo rje gtum po khyung sham can gyi cho ga dregs pa las 'khol zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// gnam sngon bskal pa'i me bos bcings 'dra 'jigs su rung ba kun tshogs pa// lha chen spyi bor rtag tu rol pas sa gsum bgegs la cher sdang ba// rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na mthu stobs rdo rje 'chang*// rje btsun bla ma khyod la 'dud do bdag snying nus pas gang bar mdzod// sham+bha la pa'i gsang ba gang*// 'phags yul grub pas gtam du bstan// mnyan pa de bzhin ras chung zhabs// gsung 'di gtum po khyung sham can// gang la pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes// grags pa'i gter mnga' de lta bu// su la'ang byed pa'i thabs 'di yis// gnyis pa rgyal ba'i zhal ma thon// de yang dpal ldan 'brug pa zhes// chos kyi snying po'i mdzod chen po/ kho nar 'dug gi gzhan gar snang*// shes pas dpyad kyin bdag lugs dge /'dir gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'di la bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor gsum/ dang po la/ tshogs bsag pa bsrung 'khor/ rten gzhal yas khang*/ brten pa lha/ byin brlab/ go cha/ spyan 'dren/ gzhug pa/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ bzlas pa/ gtor ma/ thun bsdu ba bcu gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnas su rnal 'byor gyi yo byad bsags la bdud rtsi ril bus kha dag par byas nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas byas la/ rang skad cig phyag na rdo rje'i skur gyur pa'i snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpar sbyangs/ slar 'od zer gyi lcags kyus de dag dang gdod nas grub pa'i rgyal ba'i tshogs thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la/ khro bo gtum po gdug pa 'dul// rang bzhin ye shes lnga yi dngos// rnam dag dri med sku 'chang ba// 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo 'dod pa thams cad kyi rtse 'jo mkhan rnams kyis/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta/ de dag gis dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la rjes su chags pa zhus/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga ra ti hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de dag dang lha gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag gis thog ma med dus nas// sdig pa ma lus bgyis pa rnams// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi// spyan sngar da lta so sor bshags// bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang ni// gsang sngags kun bdag rdo rje can// de rigs 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// dge ba mdzad la rjes yi rang*// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyis// gsang ba'i bdag por dbang bskur bas// gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mthu ldan skyon bral khyed rnams la// skye rga na 'chi mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du sku sprul pa// mthun 'jug mya ngan mi 'da' gsol// don dam rang bzhin mtshan ma med// rnam par mi rtog chos sku la// bde gshegs mtshan dpes brgyan snang ba// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// dus gsum mgon po thugs rje can// byams pa'i thugs las ma g.yos kyang*// dgos pa'i dbang gis drag sprul pa// gsang sngags chos la skyabs su mchi// sna tshogs sku 'dzin don bsgrub pa// 'phags pa gos sngon sems dpa' ni// rin chen skyabs mchog dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// 'khor dang bcas la lus 'bul na// bzhes nas bdag la rjes mthun pa'i// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal du gsol// shes rab snying rjer ldan pa'i byang chub sems// dus gsum rgyal bas ji ltar bskyed pa ltar// de yi rjes su bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// byang chub sems ni nam yang mi gtong ngo*// dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas// tshogs gnyis las byung dge ba rnams// 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus don// byang chub chen por bsngo bar bya// tshogs zhing rang la bstim/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba de yang rgyun brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o// bsod nams kyi tshogs so// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ phyi gzung ba'i yul thams cad stong par gyur/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems stong pa nyid du gyur/ ye shes kyi tshogs so// bsrung 'khor ni/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i gnas su rang gi sems yi ge hūm̐ lnga ldan las yi ge tsa cig 'phros/ de yongs su gyur pa las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo lte ba mu khyud steng 'og dang bcas par rtsibs bcu pa/ de dag gi nang du nyi gdan/ lte bar hūm̐ de zhugs pa las rang nyid gnod mdzes rgyal po mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab ljang ba'i zhal bzhi pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdor dril/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga khro bo'i byin dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi mtha'i me lta bu'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ bcu rtsibs su spros pa las/ shar du rnam rgyal/ lhor gshin rje gshed/ nub tu rta mgrin/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ shar lhor dbyug sngon can/ lho nub tu stobs po che/ nub byang du mi g.yo ba/ byang shar du gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ 'og tu hūm̐ ka ra/ thams cad nag po phyag gnyis rdo rje'i tho ba dang lcags kyu/ khro zhing 'khrugs pa'i zhal yas kyi mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ spyan gsum drag tu khol zhing gzir ba/

dpa' zhing sgeg pa mi sdug pa'i sku/ sbrul gyi rgyan dang stag sham can/ g.yas brkyang bas me'i phung po chen po'i khrod du nyi ma la bzhugs pa la gnod mdzes kyis/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa pa ya gṛ h+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bsgo bas khro bo bcus phyogs bcu'i gdon bgegs log 'dren bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad bzung nas gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i khar rang rang stod khro bo smad phur bu dbal me'i dong nas 'thon ma thag pa lta bu/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭā na bigh+nā na hūm̐ phaṭ/ kī li kī lā ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ badz+ra dhā ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ phur bu de dag bgegs rnams la btab pa/ gnod mdzes kyi phyag gi rdo rje tho bar gyur nas/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra kī lā ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ de dag gi mgo nas brdungs pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du btab cing me 'bar bas thal ba tsam yang mi dmigs par bsregs nas rang gi lag pa g.yas g.yon kha dang gsang bar phyogs dpung pa dang pus mo la mtshams/ spyi bo dang rkang mthil la steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhugs par gyur/ mthar mi dmigs pa stong par gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra prā kā ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sha ra dz+wa la hūṃ saṃ trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ raṃ hūm̐/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pas 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum po la rdo rje mda'i dra bas brgyan pa/

bar mtshams med pa cis kyang mi tshugs cis kyang mi shigs cis kyang mi 'jig pa'i rdo rje'i mkhar me'i phung po 'bar ba nam mkha' khyab pa'i nang du/ rten gzhal yas khang ni/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam/ de'i steng raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng tsa las gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i lte ba la bh+ruṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzhal yas khang rdo rje rin po che'i rgyal po dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba las grub pa gru bzhi pa/ rmang gi phyir 'dod pa'i lha mo gnas pa'i pad+ma rā ga'i snam bu dang ba gam dzam+bū na dī/ ha ra nag po'i steng gi gser gdung las mu tig dkar dmar gyi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ rgya phubs kyi lcam sna las thur du in+d+ra nī la'i shar bu/ steng rtsig pa'i thad du karke ta'i mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang gdugs ba dan rnam pa mang pos mdzes pa/ thog 'phar ma sum brtsegs kyi dbus phyur bu rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan cing sgo bzhi'i sgo khyud twa ra ṇa bzhis spras pa'i rtser gdugs kyis phug pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa pad+ma la gnas pa'i ri dwags zung mig mi 'dzum par lta ba/ 'bar ba bkra ba blta na sdug pa/ phyi nas bltas na nang gsal zhing*/ nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba/ rgya dang khyon blos mi 'khyud pa dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang gi dbus su sa las brdol ba'i rin po che'i pad+ma'i sdong po shin tu rgyas pa 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru la brten pa lha ni/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha gnyis las dpe byad brgyad cu mtshan pa mnyam nyid ye shes kyi bdag nyid nyi ma/

de'i steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ gnyis las mtshan so gnyis mtshon pa me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid zla ba/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dang aṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid/ aṃ las pad+ma li khri'i mdog can aṃ gis mtshan pa la phyed tsam dim pa'i hūm̐ las rdo rje mthing shun gyi mdog can hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ pad+ma de las 'od zer dmar po dang rdo rje las sngon po 'phros gsung dang thugs kyi rigs thams cad bsdus te so sor thim pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid/ de rnams gnyis su med par zhu ba dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bu'i 'od kyis sku'i rigs thams cad bsdus te thim pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum po sku mdog mthing nag drag shul chen po'i byin gyis sgeg pa/ gsus khyim che zhing nywa sul rags pa/ gnam sa tsam du gdangs pa'i khro bo'i zhal nas khams gsum za bar byed pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags dril nas rkan sgra brdabs pas srid pa gsum g.yo zhing bsgul ba/ ag tshom mer dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i khrod nas rdo rje'i me stag 'phro ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung 'tshub cing smin ma 'khyogs po las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ thod skam dang rdo rje rin po che'i thod nyis rim du bcings pa'i ral pa dmar ser gyen du gzings pa rta gdong gi ri langs pa lta bu/ phyag g.yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyi rdo rje ma rungs pa'i snying la gsor zhing*/ g.yon 'gying bag dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pas/ yum la 'khyud pa/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo'i ga sha klu chen brgyad phyag rgya drug dang rin po ches spras pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs kyis smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yon lha dbang phyug chen po lag pa stong gis rang gi gdong stong 'tshog pa de'i dpral ba mnan zhing*/

g.yas bskum pas u ma de wi'i snying ga brdzis te nyin mor byed pa la bzhugs pa'i phang du dpa' mo bde ma ljang khu bcu drug pa'i lang tsho chags pa mi zad par bdo bas gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi mgul 'khyud cing zhabs g.yon 'khril ba dang g.yas lhan cig brkyang pas pad+mar rdo rje thim pa'i dga' bas ngoms pa med par srub pa dang srub pa'i bya ba la brtson pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i cod pan dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer mo skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa gnyis chos dbyings ye shes kyi bdag nyid/ de lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras phung po khams skye mched kyi lha tshogs bskul nas zhu ba'i byang chub sems kyi rnam par mkha' gsang du byon pa cha bcu gnyis su chad de phyir 'thon/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha gnas so sor thig le'i rnam par zhugs pa rnams phyogs su hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ k+ṣaḥ grwar/ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥ sgor hūm̐ gi yig gzugs de dag yongs su gyur pa las rim pa bzhin tshad med pa'i bdag nyid kyi khro bo bzhi'i dang po shar du khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdor dril/ lhag ma gnyis rtse gsum dang be con bsnams pa/ 'byung po dang pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ lhor hūm̐ mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa srin po'i gzugs can/ rang gi sha la za ba tsam du gtum pa/ gad rgyangs dang bcas pa'i mchu las khrag 'dzag cing spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po thod 'phreng gis bcings pa phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bzung ba/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan te g.yon brkyang gis dgra bo bsgral ba'i baṃ dang pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ nub tu bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dbyug tho/

lhag ma gnyis mkha' lding a nī la dang phur bu bsnams pa/ klu chen brgyad kyi gdan dang pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ byang du 'phags pa dzam bha la'i dbang po gser mdog gnod sbyin gyi byin mi bzad pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ g.yon dbul ba sel ba'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ lha'i na bza' dang rgyan can nor bu 'bo bzhin pa'i gter bum brgyad dang pad zla la bzhugs pa/ mtshams la bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'o// shar lhor 'khor lo'i khyung dkar po g.yas 'khor lo g.yon sbrul dkar khra bzung nas za ba/ spu gshog thams cad 'khor lo'i rang bzhin can/ lho nub tu rin po che'i khyung ser po g.yas rin po che g.yon sbrul ser khra bzung nas za ba/ spu gshog thams cad rin po che'i rang bzhin can/ nub byang du pad+ma'i khyung dmar po g.yas pad+ma g.yon sbrul dmar khra bzung nas za ba/ spu gshog thams cad pad+ma'i rang bzhin can/ byang shar du ral gri'i khyung ljang khu g.yas ral gri g.yon sbrul ljang khra bzung nas za ba/ spu gshog thams cad ral gri'i rang bzhin can/ thams cad rdo rje'i rwa dang mchu sder can nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshungs pa spyan gsum pa/ shin tu gtum pa/ klu rigs bzhi so so'i gdan dang pad+ma la bzhugs pa/ shar sgor thugs kyi khro bo stobs ldan nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs kar rdo rjes thod khrag dkrug pa/ khyab 'jug gi gdan dang pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ lho sgor sku'i khro bo rdo rje 'jigs byed mthing nag ma he'i gdong can phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin cing gcer bu rgyan med liṅga gyen du bsgreng ba/ 'chi bdag gshin rje gdan dang pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ nub sgor gsung gi khro bo rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbang phyug gi gdan dang pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ byang sgor 'phrin las kyi khro bo rdo rje gzhon nu zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs kar rdo rje phur bu bsgril ba/

tshangs pa'i gdan dang pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ khro bo'i dbang po drug ka'ang mi sdug pa'i gzugs can zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum 'bar ba 'jigs su rung zhing gel la brjid pa/ ral pa bshor po sbrul gyi rgyan dang lnga la dar gyi lhubs gon dang stag sham gyis spras te g.yas brkyang bas tsha zer can la bzhugs pa me'i pa tras bskor ba/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba la sogs pas kyang brgyan pa'o// dkyil 'khor gyi mtha'i khor yug tu gos sngon can lnga brgya/ klu chen brgyad la sogs pa'i klu/ lha ma srin dregs pa can thams cad kyis bskor ba'o// byin brlab ni/ lha tshogs de thams cad kyi lus la oṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku yi byin brlabs bsdus/ de la thim pas lus gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin ngag la āḥ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs bsdus te thim pas ngag gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gsung rdo rje/ sems la hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin brlabs bsdus te thim pas yid gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtso bo dang 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar sgrib pa rnam sel ser po rnga yab/ mig tu sa'i snying po ser po shing gi yal 'dab/ rna bar phyag na rdo rje sngon po rdo rje/ snar nam mkha'i snying po ljang khu nor bu/ lce la 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po pad+ma/ snying gar kun tu bzang po sngon po ral gri/ yum gyi dpral bar reg bya rdo rje ma gos zung*/ mig tu gzugs rdo rje ma me long*/ rna bar sgra rdo rje ma pi wang*/ sna la dri rdo rje ma spos snod/ lce la ro rdo rje ma ro snod/ snying gar chos kyi rdo rje ma 'khyud stangs mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang khro bo dang bcas pas yab g.yon yum g.yas brkyang ste pad zla la gnas pa/

go cha ni/ yab kyi spyi bor oṃ las bud+dha he ru ka dkar po/ mgrin par hrīḥlas pad+ma he ru ka dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje he ru ka sngon po/ lte bar trāṃ las rin chen he ru ka ser po/ gsang gnas su a las karma he ru ka ljang khu g.yas 'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje rin po che ral gri /g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ he ru ka'i chas can g.yon brkyang*/ lag pa g.yas pa rnam rgyal/ g.yon pa gshin rje gshed/ kha la rta mgrin/ gsang bar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ dpung pa g.yas su mi g.yo ba/ g.yon du gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ rkang pa gnyis la gnod mdzes rgyal po/ de thams cad kyang phyag gnyis nas bsrung 'khor bzhin nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ yum gyi spyi bor sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo mgrin par gos dkar dmar mo/ snying gar mā ma kī sngon mo/ lte bar nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ser mo/ gsang gnas su sgrol ma ljang khu/ thams cad kyang khro mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yon g.yas/ zhal dang gsang ba dpung pa g.yon g.yas/ pus mo gnyis dang*/ spyi bo dang rkang par rim pa bzhin/ rdo rje ro langs ma dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje ma dang*/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang*/ sna tshogs rin chen ma dang*/ khro gnyer can ma dang*/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ ral gcig ma dang*/ sna tshogs las ma dang*/ nam mkha'i rdo rje ma dang*/ sa 'dzin ma ste khro mo bcu gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ bco lnga po g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ snying gar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje sngon po nas 'bru tsam/ de'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba/ spyan 'dren ni/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs/ gnyis med stong pa'i rang bzhin las// smon lam snying rje'i mthu stobs kyis// bsam gyis mi khyab dkyil 'khor che// bde gshegs gtso bo gtum po dang*// lha rnams phyogs su 'khod pa dag /bdag dang sems can rgyud sbyang phyir// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la/ mchod bstod ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug nam mkha' khyab par spros pa rnams kyis/ bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'phrul// sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐ khro bo gtum po gdug pa 'dul// rang bzhin ye shes lnga yi dngos// rnam dag dri med sku 'chang ba// 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs sku la gnyis med 'khyud// stong pa nyid kyi bde ster ma// dmar ljang gri gug thod pa 'dzin// dpa' mo bde ma phyag 'tshal lo// yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba'i thabs// byang sems las byung khro bo'i tshogs// 'phrin las don la mnga' brnyes pa// phyogs mtshams sgor bzhugs rnams la bstod// gzhug pa ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang bskur rgyas btab ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs/ de rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi lha rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyun gyis spyi bo gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang dbang thob/ snying ga gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang nas gyen du gshegs pas rnam shes kyi cha dag dbang bzhi pa thob pas sangs rgyas lnga thod pa'i pho brang dang rdo rje sems dpa' gtsug tu bzhugs shing*/ 'khor rnams la rang rigs kyi sangs rgyas zhi ba'i tshul can gyis rgyas gdab/

de lta bu'i 'khor lo ci tsam nus kyi bar du bsgom mo// bzlas brjod dang gtor ma bya ba ni/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭ/ sku'i snying po/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī laṃ ba ra dhā ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsung gi snying po/ oṃ badz+ra tsan+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ thugs kyi snying po/ oṃ badz+ra trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta nā ga hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ku be rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bud+dha ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rat+na ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pad+ma ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ karma ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ḍā na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ha ya gṝ ba hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra ki li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'khor sngags so// dmigs pa man ngag bzhin no// gtso bo 'bum la 'khor khri bzla'o// mtshan nyi shu rtsa gcig pas bstod pa yang mang du bya'o// des pad+ma 'byung gnas lta bu'i nus pa thob par 'gyur ro// thun mtshams gtor ma ni/ bza' ba dang bca' bar smos pa thams cad kyi gtor ma dang*/ myos byed kyi btung ba'i snod bsangs sbyangs/ 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam g.yo ba ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa de'i zur gsum du hūm̐ las rdo rje langs pa/ de'i steng du āḥlas pad+ma'i snod chen po stong gsum khyab pa tsam phyi dkar la nang dmar ba chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin/ de'i steng du su ra ma hūm̐ a las bdud rtsi lnga/ steng du bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin can gnas pa/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ steng du maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ baṃ yum lnga'i rang bzhin/ nyi ma dmar pos kha bcad pa'i steng du rdo rje dkar po/ lag pa g.yas pa bkab/ oṃ las rdzas de thams cad kyi ma dag pa sbyangs/

g.yon bkab/ āḥmang por spel/ snyim pa bkab/ hūm̐ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos por sbar/ kha'i nyi ma zhu bas thams cad zangs kyi zhun mar lta bur khol ba shes rab/ rdo rje zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bu babs pa'i thabs gnyis ro gcig tu 'dres pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po chen por rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu sogs kyis ngag tu/ pheṃ/ lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor/ rkang pa g.yon gyis g.yas mnan/ tshogs zhing bzhin mchod/ de rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse gsum sbu gu can gyi rtse gtor snod du btsugs/ gtso bo la sogs pa la snying po'i mthar/ sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā his phul/ khor yug pa rnams la/ oṃ in+d+ra/ ya ma/ dza la/ yak+ṣa bhū ta/ pa ni/ wā yu/ rāk+sha sa/ tsan+d+ra/ sur+ya/ mā ta/ pas+yā/ ta la/ pa tā la/ uṣ+ṭa/ sad+yā swāhā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dzi ga puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ māṃ sa/ biṅga/ āt+ma/ sarba kañdza swāhā/ khan+ti/ khuti/ phe da/ ga to/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+yanu t+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ 'byung ba thams cad la sbyin no// sngar bzhin bstod/ 'dod pa'i don gsol/ hūm̐/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// rang gi gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang spyan drangs tshe na byon// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya muḥ gshegs so// phan yon/ mchod sbyin 'di dang ma bral na// zhi sogs grub pa brgyad gang yin// mchog gi 'bras bu thob par 'gyur// zhes so// dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ badz+ra muḥ 'khor rnams rang rang gi gnas so sor bsdus/ yum rang dang*/ rang spyi bo nas yas zhu/ rkang mthil nas mas zhu/ snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' de rim gyis yal bas stong nyid la bzhag

de nas skad cig gis dpa' bo gcig pa'i tshul du langs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs kyis dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o// gnyis pa bsgrub pa la/ nub dang po sa chog nub gnyis pa sta gon/ nub gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ dbang bskur ba bzhi las/ dang po la/ bslang brtag sbyang gzung ba bzhi/ dang po rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsnyen pa legs par thems pa la rdo rje gtum po'i sgor 'jug par 'dod pa'i slob mas gsol ba gdab la/ slob dpon des kyang bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas gtor ma sbyin la/ mdun du dri'i thig le me tog gi tshom bu mtha' mchod gtor bkod pa/ mdun du laṃ las sa'i lha mo nas/ de nyid du thim par gyur spyi mthun sa bslang ba'o// de nas sa gsar pa stegs bu bya dgos pa yod na lto 'phye brtags la brko// ro lnga bsal gter bcug bkra shis pa la dbyibs gru bzhi tsam dgos pa dbus mtho shar dang byang gzhol bar bya/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa la ni de lta bu bya mi dgos/ brtag pa'o// de nas rgyas par zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ gzhan swa bhā was sbyangs/ 'byung ba ri rab gzhal yas khang du yud kyis bsam mo// sa sbyang ba'o// de nas der rdo rje la me tog gis bcings pa bzhag sa gzung ba'o// gnyis pa la/ sa bsrung ba/ lha/ bum pa/ slob ma sta gon bzhi/ dang po slob dpon phyag rgya drug dang ldan pas bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas/ slob ma bzhi rnam rgyal la sogs pa 'khor bzhi'i nga rgyal gyis rang phyogs nas mchod bstod/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// sogs spyi mthun/ de nas 'khor rnams bsdus rang nyid byang shar du song gtso bo'i nga rgyal mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma/ g.yon par ṭa las zla ba dang*/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las bskal pa'i mer 'bar bar bsams te rdo rje lta stangs kyis phyogs thams cad du bltas la/

hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha sogs bgegs rnams kun nyon cig nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar/ bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'gro bar gyis// gal te khyod rnams mi 'gro na// ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gems shing*// lus rnams dum bu stong gyur nas// rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za// de bas khyed rnams gzhan du dengs// oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sarba bi gh+na na u ts+tsha ṭa ya phaṭ/ ces bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje 'gros kyis bskor/ byang shar du sleb pa dang*/ gang dag mi 'gro'i bgegs yod na// lus ngag yid kyi nus pa rnams// gzhom phyir khro bo'i phur bu gdab// ces rang nyid gnod mdzes rgyal po nas bsrung 'khor bzhin las kyi rdo rjes phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu phur bu bcu gdab bo// oṃ me dī ni sogs kyis ra gur bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas lha gnas ma 'chol bar gtso bo'i gnas su gru bzhi/ 'khor gnas su zlum po dris byug tshom bu bkod mchod pas bskor/ swa bhā was/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes lha skad cig gis bskyed nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyi bar byas/ lha mo bcu drug dang rgyal srid sna bdun gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs gzugs// mthing nag nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// rdo rje dril 'dzin g.yon brkyang bas// dbang phyug mnan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la 'khril// dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin// stong pa'i gzugs can wā rā hī// rdo rje bde mar phyag 'tshal bstod// byams pa'i rang bzhin rnam par rgyal// dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// rdor dril rtse gsum be con 'dzin// 'byung po 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// snying rje'i rang bzhin legs ldan che// nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// gri gug 'phyar zhing thod khrag 'thung*// dgra bo sgrol la phyag 'tshal bstod// dga' ba'i rang bzhin bdud rtsi 'khyil// ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// rdo rje khyung dang dbyug phur 'dzin// klu 'dul chen por=

btang snyoms rang bzhin dzam+bha la// ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// nor bu'i rgyal mtshan ne'u le 'dzin// dbul 'phongs sel la phyag 'tshal bstod// rtag pa'i rigs chen 'khor lo'i khyung*// dkar po 'khor lo sbrul dkar 'dzin/ kha rlangs dug can rje rigs klu// ma lus 'dul la= nyi ma'i rigs chen rin chen khyung*// ser po nor bu sbrul ser 'dzin// mthong ba'i dug can rgyal rigs klu// ma lus 'dul la= rta mchog rigs chen pad+ma'i khyung*// dmar po chu skyes sbrul dmar 'dzin// bsam pa'i dug can bram ze'i klu// ma lus 'dul la= don yod rigs chen las kyi khyung*// ljang khu ral gri sbrul ljang 'dzin// reg pa'i dug can dmangs rigs klu// ma lus 'dul la= thugs kyi khro rgyal stobs ldan che// mthing nag zhal gcig khro la phyag /thugs kar rdo rjes thod khrag dkrug /phung bdud 'joms la= sku yi khro rgyal 'jigs byed che// mthing nag ma he'i zhal la phyag /gri gug thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin// 'chi bdud 'joms la= gsung gi khro bo pad+ma dbang*// mthing nag gtsug na rta mchog phyag /ral gri 'phyar zhing sdigs mdzub mdzad// nyon bdud 'joms la= 'phrin las khro rgyal phur pa che// mthing nag zhal gcig khro la phyag /rdo rje phur bu bgegs la bsgril// lha bdud 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas spos thogs te// hūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal// bdag la dgongs nas gzigs su gsol// slob ma rnams kyi don phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// bdag ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// rin po che yi mthu bzhin du// bka' drin rjes su gnang ba yi// sang ni 'byon par mdzad du gsol// lan gsum gyis snyan gsan phab// bum pa sta gon ni/ de nas bum pa bzang po lha grangs sam dgu'am lnga'am gnyis/ nad sbyong ba sman lnga/ ye shes 'phel ba rin po che lnga/

'phrin las bsgrub pa a ka ru bsnan/ gla rtsi med pa'i dri lnga/ phun tshogs 'phel ba snying po lnga rnams dang bcas pa'i chus dgang*/ mgul gos kyis dkris/ gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa khar bzhag 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i shing me tog yod pas kha brgyan/ rang rang gi lha'i mtshan ma dgod/ phyogs so sor bzhag pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du ku sha'i gdan la sogs pa la'o// swa bhā was/ bum pa mi dmigs pa las/ rnam rgyal chen po dung chos su bhūṃ las gzhal yas khang*/ zhes nas lha tshogs thams cad bskyed/ bum pa gzhan rnams bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum par dmigs pa'i nang du lha grangs yin na so so/ lnga yin na phyogs mtshams gnyis sdom/ gnyis yin na rnam rgyal du thams cad/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed par bya ste 'don pa gcig nub dang las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sogs tsam bsgyur gis so// de la bstod pa'i bar grub nas/ gzungs thag bzung*/ 'phrin las gang byed kyi dmigs pas bzlas pa bya/ gtor mas mchod/ 'dod don gsol te/ 'od du zhu dus rnam rgyal gyi gtso bo yab yum nas rim bzhin bum par thim pas thams cad kyang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam mo// slob ma sta gon ni/ de nas tshom bu yol bas bcad pa'i phyir slob ma bsags khrus byas/ gos rgyan bzang pos brgyan/ me tog dang bcas pas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa che// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen por bdag 'tshal lo nas/ bdag ni gzhug par mdzod// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob ma rnams phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od 'phog pas thams cad kyang gsung pad+ma'i rigs su byas pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag hūm̐ hūm̐ tsit+ta badz+ra gtum po yab yum du gsal ba'i bla ma'i khar 'ub cer 'dus nas a ba dhū tī'i nang na mar sngo si li li 'thon pas thugs su byas yid kyi sgrib pa dag

rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+ma brgyud skur byas phyir rnam snang gi rnam par 'thon nas lus kyi sgrib pa dag āḥhūm̐ oṃ/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// dus gsum byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje gsang sngags mthu yis ni// mnyam med ye shes yang dag 'thob// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mchod cing*// rtsa ba yan lag nyes pa spongs// ma grol 'khor ba'i sems can la// snying rje chen po rab bskyed nas// bsgral zhing grol ba'i lam la bkod// bde bar dbugs ni dbyung bar gyis/ sdom pa sbyin/ spro na 'og bzhin gyi bsgrag gzung yang bya'o// slob ma'i gnas gsum du hūm̐ āḥ oṃ las sku rdo rje gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje bskyed/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs dzaḥ hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas de dag la mchod pa lnga dbul lo// mchod sbyin gyi shing gsar pa rtse mor me tog bcings pa sprad dus/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir// zhugs pa'i dngos grub brtag pa'i phyir// rnam shes dag pa'i so shing 'di// sos bzung nas ni dbus su dor/ kha shar du bltas/ sos bzung nas pad+ma'i phyag rgyas bor du gzhug bdag dang bla ma steng bltas na// mchog gi dngos grub dam pa yin// phyogs su 'phrin las so so ste// mtshams su 'jig rten dngos grub 'byung*// thur bltas sa 'og 'grub pa yin// sa la ma lhung mkha' spyod do// bdud rtsi byin brlab thod par blug /bdud rtsi 'di ni rdo rje chu// 'thung zhing dam tshig byin gyis brlab// gal te dam tshig 'das pa ni// dmyal bar nges par bsreg par 'gyur// oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sogs kyis sbyin/

hub gsum 'thung*/ lhag ma rgyab tu dor bas khrus/ skud pa sngon po lha dang las mthun pa mdud pa brgyab/ lha'i sngags bzlas pa dang po g.yas/ gnyis pa g.yon du bcings/ hūm̐/ khro bo gtum po'i byin rlabs dang*// gsang sngags nus pa bla med kyis// skal ldan bar chad med par srungs// su yang gnod pa ma byed cig /dri chus rdo rje rgya gram gyi brlan par bya'o// ku sha bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bzlas pa gdan dang sngas su che chung byas pa byin te/ hūm̐/ bzhin bzang tshur nyon dkyil 'khor du// 'jug pa'i rtags rnams brtag pa'i phyir// ku sha'i rtswa 'di sngas dang stan// thub pas ting 'dzin grub ltar shog /ces brjod// de yang seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi khang par nyal/ rmi lam brtag bzang na spro ba bskyed/ ngan na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la sogs pas bzlog par bya'o// nub gsum pa la/ thig tshon/ bsgrub pa/ bdag 'jug bzhi las dang po/ lha sta gon nam mkhar yid kyis bteg la/ slob dpon rdo rje 'chang du dmigs pas/ gang yang gsang sngags lha rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba ma lus dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub la zhugs dang*// sangs rgyas bstan dga'i 'byung po dang*// yang dag rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams// rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil 'khor mchog /deng bdag bri bar 'gyur ba la// bdag dang skal mnyam slob ma la// byin gyis brlab phyir srung bar mdzod/ ces brjod nas/ bu mo gtsang mas bkal ba'i srad bu nyi shu rtsa lnga'am lnga ye shes lngar/ yang na gsum bsgril te sku gsung thugs kyi nges pas so// oṃ āḥ.a n+yo sogs kyis dril/ thod par bdud rtsi lngas brlan par byas te/ slob mas rdo rje dang bcas bla mar gtad/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas ye shes pa bstim/ dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes bskul/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ nam mkhar btab pas grib ma bzhin sa la gsal bar blta'o// de'i rjes su mthun pas las thig gdab/

phyogs 'khrul spang bar bya'o// gnyis pa thod pa lngar tshon bzhag ste snying po'i sngags gdab/ bh+rūṃ aṃ dzṛṃ khaṃ hūm̐ du bltas la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥye shes pa bstim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon gyis dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas sngon po/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed// dpal ldan rdo rje'i 'dzin pa dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ de bzhin/ ljang khu/ sor rtog dmar po mnyam nyid/ ser po bya grub/ dkar po me long ye shes sogs kyis so// me tog dor la tshon pra brtag skyon med par bri'o// gsum pa/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi steng phyogs thams cad bkod pa'i khyad par dang mchod pa'i yo byad kyis legs par brgyan/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal gzung nas hūm̐ zhes bsgrags/ oṃ badz+ra uta ghaṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐ zhes pa sgo bzhi phye ba'i shar sgo nas zhugs par bsam la/ bdag bskyed/ sta gon bzhin mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed byas/ bzhi pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba bzhin bdag 'jug spro na shar du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o// bzhi pa dbang bskur ba la/ 'jug pa dang*/ dbang dngos gnyis/ dang po/ de nas shar du dbang stegs la slob ma bzhag slob dpon dbang ldan du gnas pa la me tog dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ thugs kyi sras po rdo rje 'dzin// gdug pa 'dul mdzad gtum po yis// slob ma smin par bya ba'i phyir// bdag la dbang bskur sbyin par mdzod// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ las bum gyis/ hūm̐ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba pā paṃ sho dha ni sarba sho dha ni swāhā/ khrus bya/ slob ma rdo rje gtum por bskyed// oṃ badz+ra ban+dha tra tha kā ya wā ka tsit+ta ces pa'i sngags kyis sdig pa phral/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum bsam/ oṃ a kā ros bgegs la gtor ma sbyin/

bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya ka bdud kyi rgyal po dga' rab dbang phyug la sogs sa bla sa steng sa 'og na gnas pa'i gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad tshim par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su song zhig ces bsgo'o// zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bskrad/ slob dpon gyi gnas gsum nas rim pa bzhin 'od zer 'phros slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas sdig pa sbyangs/ yi ge gsum 'khod// oṃ kā ya shud+dhaḥsarba dhar+m+māḥkā ya shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ wā ka shud+dhaḥ sarba dhar+m+māḥ wā ka shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ tsit+ta shud+dhaḥ sarba dhar+m+māḥtsit+ta shud+dho ྅haṃ/ de nas slob ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge sku gsung thugs kyi lhar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcings/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dri/ slob mas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi// gtso bo khro bor bcas pa yi// lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni skal bzang rigs yin te// rdo rje 'dzin pa khyed la dga'// 'phrin las rdo rje 'dzin la rdzogs// de bas de yi rigs 'dzin 'tshal// lha mchog gtum po che la skyabs// thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par mdzod// ci 'byor pa yi 'jug yon phul// phyi 'jug oṃ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ yol ba bsal nang du btang*/ dkyil 'khor la bskor nas shar phyogs su bzhag bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskul/ des phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskul nas slob ma'i tshangs bug tu thim/ des sku'i byin brlabs bsdus/ phung po'i bdud bcom pas khyab 'jug mnan/ mar babs mgrin par gsung gi byin rlabs bsdus nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom pas dbang phyug mnan/ mar babs snying gar thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom brgya byin mnan/ de ni lha'i bu'i bdud bcom bgegs bsal ba'o// dkyil 'khor gyi lha la na ma te hūm̐/

na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ phyag gsum bya/ de nas thal mo sbyar te shar nas/ oṃ trai lo kya bi dza ya pū dzo pa s+thā nā ya āt+ma nī ni r+yā ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga to ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ lha'i byin rlabs kyis snying ga'i brgya byin gyi khar mi bskyod pa/ lho nas/ oṃ mahā kā la pū dzo bas+thā nā ya āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta tha ga ta rat+na saṃ bha wa/ a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ spyi bor khyab 'jug gi steng du rnam snang*/ nub nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li pū dzo pas+thā nā ya/ āt+ma nāṃ nar+yī ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma dha ri a bhiṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ mgrin par dbang phyug chen po'i steng du 'od dpag med/ byang nas/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la pū dzo pas+thā nā ya/ āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ/ lha de thams cad kyi phyag g.yas su tshangs pa'i gzugs re/ de nas las bum gyis khrus byas yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// dkyil 'khor me tog sngon por bcas// rdo rje 'chang la dbul bar bya// bdud rtsi rnam lnga'i gtor ma'i tshogs// rnam pa kun tu bsten par bya// thabs kyis bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni// snying rje las byung bsgral bar bya// zhes lan gsum/ de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la// rdo rje sems dpa' bla na med// bdag la da lta bskyed du gsol// spos kyis bdug cing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad lhag pa'i lha'i rnam par spyan drangs slob ma la bstim pas gnyis su med pa'i bde bas khyab par gyur/ 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste// rdo rje gtum po sems dpa' che// ye shes rdo rje bla na med// da lta nyid du 'bab par shog

/oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa ā be sha ya s+t+wam+bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya/ āḥ hūm̐ mahādzhaiḥbadz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa aḥ ā be sha ya aḥ a a a a/ zhes bzlas lus ngag yid gsum gang la babs na'ang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te sa ma ya/ sngags des brtan par byas la/ de'i lce la a bsams nas dge mi dge dri'o// me tog rdo rje dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gtum po deng khyod kyi// snying la sogs dang*/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i ka pā la'i bdud rtsi byin/ 'di ni khyod kyi rdo rje chu// dam tshig 'das na sogs// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ud ka ṭha hūm̐/ de nas shar du 'dug ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod rnams kyi// rdo rje gtum po nga yin gyis/ khyed kyi nga la brnyas pa na// mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas// dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re// zhes dam la bzhag gsang ba bla med me tog 'di// pho brang dkyil 'khor lha mchog la// las dang rjes su brtse ba yis// rigs dang mthun par 'bab par shog /pra tīts+tsha hoḥbadz+ra/ phyogs bzhi dbus la rigs dang dngos grub/ lhag par lha'i stod sked smad nye ring gtso 'khor las bye brag gi dngos grub brtag par bya'o// de nas dor ba'i me tog de bla mas slob ma'i mgor bcing*/ oṃ dharma kun+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa/ me tog phog pa'i lha bstim/ ming gi phyir rigs nges par bya ba'o// sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis// ma rig ling tog bsal ba ltar// de bzhin khyod kyi mig dbye bas// ye shes mig gis mthong bar shog /badz+ra tsak+ṣu pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ gdong g.yog bsal/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// mthong nas dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su 'gyur// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te/ dngos grub ma lus snod du 'gyur// rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gzhal yas khang ngo*// zhes pas dkyil 'khor dang*/

mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lnga ru rab tu grags// rdo rje skye mched nyid dag ni// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ces dang*/ yan lag dag ni khro bo bcu// zhes pa lha ste kun rdzob kyi dag pa/ sna tshogs de bzhin nyid bdag med// thabs ni snying rje stobs yin te// zung du 'jug pa rnam rtog bral// dkyil 'khor snying po mchog yin no// zhes pas don dam pa'i de nyid bshad do// 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa dbang dngos la/ bum gsang gsum pa tshig dbang las/ dang po la/ rig pa'i dbang dang slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis kyi dang po/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas sogs kyi mthar/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni slob dpon mchog bgyid do// zhes pas gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du slob ma hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra ba'i mā ma kī la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsam/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis shes rab dang bcas pa'i ye shes pa gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥslob ma la thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo'i rgyal po yab yum rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i mos pas/ bum pa rnams kyi chu rnam rgyal du bsdus te rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ sku gsum dam tshig las byung ba'i// ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med// lha yi bdud rtsi rnam dag 'dis// mi bskyod rdo rje dbang bskur ro// oṃ ā dar+sha dz+nyā na a bhiṣiñtsa hūm̐/

chu yi dbang bskur dam pa 'dis// sgrib pa rnam pa gsum bral nas// mi 'khrugs rnam dag ye shes 'thob// mi bskyod rdo rje dngos grub shog /dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa dang slob ma trāṃ las rin chen 'byung gnas sku mdog ser po rin po che dang rin po che'i dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra ba'i rin chen rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa nas ye shes pa cha gnyis slob ma dang dbang rdzas la bstim/ 'od du zhu ba sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid cod pan du gyur/ rin po che'i cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa mgo la bskon/ dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa 'dis// sems can tshim par byed pa'i mchog /yid bzhin bsam pa 'grub byed pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta dz+nyā na yu ku ṭa tiṣ+ṭha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbu rgyan dbang bskur dam pa 'dis// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas bde bar gshegs// bdag gi mgo la brgyan gyur te// rin chen 'byung ldan dngos grub shog /rdo rje dang slob ma hrīḥlas 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang pad+ma'i dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra ba'i gos dkar mo la 'khyud pa nas/ 'od du zhu ba rdo rjer gyur/ lag pa g.yas su gtad/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// mi phyed rnam dag 'od gsal te// dam chos 'byung ba'i sgor gyur pa// rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra pra ti ā be sha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur dam pa 'dis// rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ khyod kyi rgyud la skyes gyur te// snang ba mtha' yas dngos grub shog /dril bu dang slob ma a las don grub sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang ral gri'i dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra ba'i sgrol ma la 'khyud pa nas/ 'od du zhu ba dril bur gyur/ g.yon du gtad/ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yi// 'gro don mnyam pa med byed pa// 'dod pa'i 'phrin las rdzogs byed pa'i// dril bu las kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ a dhi ta na a nu ta dza dz+nyā pa ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

dril bu'i dbang bskur dam pa 'dis// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// gsung gi dngos grub bdag gyur te// don yod grub pa'i dngos gru shog /slob ma bhūṃ las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pa rang 'dra ba'i spyan mas 'khyud pa nas/ spyi bor 'khor lo thogs pas ming gdags/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// byang chub thob kyi bar du ni// cis kyang gzhom par mi nus pa'i// rdo rje'i ming du rab tu grags// oṃ pra ti sho dha dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na nā ma a bhiṣiñtsa mi hūm̐/ ming gi dbang bskur dam pa 'dis// stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya ru// sprul pas 'gro la chos ston cing*// rnam snang dngos grub thob par shog /gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ slob ma seng ge'i khri la bzhag steng du gdugs dkar po bzung la des/ slob dpon rang bzhin 'od dpag mchog /skal pa chen po bdag la stsol// bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang bskur ni// sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa// de bzhin sangs rgyas dpag med dang*// brtul zhugs bla na med pa de// ji ltar 'dul bzhin bdag la stsol// slob ma gtso bo yab yum du bskyed/ byin rlabs go cha ye shes bstim// rnam rgyal bum pas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po yi// sogs kyis mthar/ 'phrin las thogs pa med pa rnams// bu yis gzhan don bla med byos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i slob dpon yin// dus gsum sangs rgyas sras yin no// de nas chos gos kyi sna ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs sogs/ kye che ge zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro// sid+dhi badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ta thā ga ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur+bhu waḥ swaḥ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// khyed la lung bstan byas pa 'di// gsang sngags rdo rje'i mthu yin pas// dad pas 'di la spro bar gyis// de nas lag tu rdo rje gtad nas/

'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ka s+t+waṃ dhā ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ de nas dril bu sbyin/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes sogs sh+lo ka oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi ghaṇ+ḍe sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ka s+t+waṃ dhā ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ de nas mig thur gyis/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po sogs/ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ de nas me long bstan/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan/ sh+lo ka de nas me long rdo rje'i gzugs snang ba bstan/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// bu khyod kyi ni snying la gnas// sangs rgyas kun bdag rang bzhin no// hoḥyig las byung ba'i mda' gzhu hoḥbarjod pas sbyin/ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya swa/ mda' 'phang ba'i tshul/ bdud la 'bigs pa'i blos phyogs bzhi steng dang 'og tu 'phang bar bya'o// de nas hūm̐ las skyes pa'i 'khor lo rkang 'og tu bcug la/ de ring phan chad 'jig rten la// skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo bskor// chos kyi 'khor lo skyon med pa// kun tu dri med sdig dang bral// de nas dung byin/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// sogs sh+lo kas/ de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan thogs drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang*// khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad// rigs lnga rim pa bzhin bsam ste phyag mtshan rnams/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i// sems can khams ni drang ba'i phyir// chags pa med pa'i bsam pa yis// ji ltar gdul bya sna tshogs la// chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar gyis// de bzhin rigs kyis gang 'dul ba/ khyod kyi 'phrin las mchog yin no// zhes rdo rje rin chen pad+ma/ las kyi tshig 'don pa bsgyur ro// dgang blugs gtad/ deng nas gzung ste rigs kyi bu// zhi rgyas dbang dang bsad pa dang*// dgug dang bcing dang bsreg pa dang*// bskrad dang dbye ba la sogs pa'i// 'phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par gyis// ral gri gtad/

ral gri mig smin sa 'og dang*// mchil lahwam de bzhin ril bu ste// thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa// de dag khyod kyis sgrub par gyis// de nas/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// mthong ba dang ni zhugs pa yis// sdig pa kun las nges par grol// khyed rnams 'di la the tshom med// de ring khyed rnams legs par gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// slar khyod 'chi ba yod ma yin// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// zhes dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod// me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi// zhes sogs bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi dbang bya ba bum dbang ngo*// gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med bya ba thob// de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// mgon pos rjes su gzung bar mdzod// bla ma gtso bo yab yum rdo rje pad+ma 'du bya ba sngon du 'gro bas snyoms par zhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā gaṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa spyan drangs kha nas zhugs 'od du gyur pa a wa dhū tī nas brgyud rdo rje nor bur lhan cig skyes pa brtan par byas rang gi byang chub kyi sems dang gnyis su med par gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// sogs kyis sbyin/ slob mas rdo rje dang pad+ma nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'das pa'i blos/ a ho mahā su kha zhes brjod de 'thung ngo*// gsum pa ni/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab// slob ma gtum por bskyed/ phyag rgya phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje bde mar gsal btab nas/ gzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags// 'khor lo'i rim par sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis// rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni// nor bu'i nang du tshud pa blta// des kyang skye gnas gur gum la sogs pa'i dri zhim par byas gos dang bral bas lag pas bgrad de slob ma la ston cing*/

e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di nas 'di nyid la ni rtag tu gnas/ bhāñdza mok+ṣa hoḥ de nas āḥlas pad+ma ze'u 'bru aṃ ཿmtshan pa dang*/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa gnyi ga'i bu ga phaṭ ser pos bkag pa bha ga'i g.yon gyi rtser hrīḥdamar po/ mdzub mos/ oṃ shī shī shī ha ha ha/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu sogs brjod/ snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i mthar lhan skyes ngos zin par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ de nas tshig kho nas bzhi pa sbyin par bya ste/ de nyid ni shes rab ye shes kyi myu gur btang ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas 'phel 'grib med pa dang ldan pa'i de kho na nyid chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin te yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bor brjod par bya'o// zhes pas so// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad bsags pa bdud rtsis chos 'byung bris pa'i steng du bzhag slob dpon gyis/ a ha ra shud+dhāḥsarbadhar+m+māḥ.a ha ra shud+dho3haṃ/ mang du bzlas pas dag par bya/ de nas gtor ma bzhin byin gyis brlab/ slob dpon gyis a las dril bu dang*/ hūm̐ las rdo rje bskyed de rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab pa dang gcig tu 'dres par bsam ste/ oṃ a mṛ te sā dhu hūm̐ ci nus bzlas/ de nas tshogs phud cha lnga/ dang po/ rdo rje 'chang chen po nas rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi phyag na rdo rje'i dbang rgyud man ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ gnyis pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du= gsum pa/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du= bzhi pa/ dpal gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro dam pa chos skyong ba'i bsrungs ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du=

lnga pa/ yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag thams cad dang rigs drug 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du= phul/ rnal 'byor mchod pa byas te rdo rje slob dpon la gzigs shig sogs kyis drangs/ longs spyad/ gtor ma btang*/ lhag ma bsdus te kha phru btab/ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa sogs kyis bsngo'o// deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas// bdag gi gson pa 'bras bur bcas// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// zhes brjod cing bla mar yon mi zad pa phul/ bla mas mchod bstod byas yi ge brgya pa bton/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor bdag gi thugs kar bsdu/ rdul tshon a kā ro'i sngags kyis dbyi/ mthar dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis brjod/ rdul tshon chu bo chen por bskyal/ klu chog bya'o// gsum pa las sbyor ni/ gdug pa klu 'dul bar 'dod pas bdag skyed sngar bzhin la/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad mtha' chu'i ri mo yod pa/ mthar mchod pa/ chu dar la sku bzhengs pa'i dmigs rten/ rgyab tu chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags dang rtsa sngags gser las ma byas pa rten du btsugs so// baṃ las rgya mtsho/ de'i nang du sum las ri rab/ de'i steng du pad nyi'i gdan gyi khar rang gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ gcig 'phros pa las rdo rje'i khyung klu 'dul zil gnon chen po sku mdog mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing ba'i zhal gsum/ de'i steng du ljang ser dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ de'i steng du nag sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum thams cad spyan gsum rdo rje'i mchu dang rwa spyi bo na rin po che/ phyag bco brgyad kyi g.yas dgu na rdo rje/ ral gri /dgra sta zhags pa mdung lcags kyu mda' rtse gsum bya khyung dang bcas pas rim pa bzhin/ chu bdag mthing ka mtha' yas ljang khu/ nor rgyas ser po/ stobs rgyu nag po/ dung skyong dmar skya/ pad+ma ser po/ pad chen ser skya/ rigs ldan ljang ser/

'jog po dmar nag ro stod lha la sbrul mgo bdun pa lag gnyis thal mo sbyar bas gtso bo la rin po che stob pa dag gi mjug ma'i rtse phyag gis bzung zhing lan gsum gdu bu bzhin du dkris pa/ g.yon pa dgu na dril bu be con 'khor lo rgya gram thod dbyug sbrul gyi rgyal mtshan gzhu gtum chung gi phur pa dang khyung gi phur pa/ rlung 'byin ma dang*/ dga' ma dang*/ mdzes ldan ma/ dpa' mo 'od byed ma/ grub ma/ bstan ma/ dge ma/ gsal byed ma stod lha mo la sbrul mgo gsum pa lag gnyis thal sbyar pad+mo 'dzin pa/ gzhan snga ma lta bu/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yas gnyis bskum pas chu srin sngon po dang ru sbal ser po/ g.yon gnyis brkyang bas phag nag dang lto 'phye ser po brdzis pa/ gshog pa rdo rje dkar ser dmar ljang*/ mjug ma ral gri dkar ser dmar ljang*/ sder mo gnam lcags me 'bar ba/ rab tu gtum pas sa bdag klu gnyan ma lus pa brlag par mdzad pa/ sku 'og min du sleb pas srid gsum khyab pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ spyi bo snying ga mgrin pa lte ba gsang gnas rnams su oṃ hūm̐ hrī/ trāṃ/ a las 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma rin po che ral gri'i khyung*/ dpung pa gnyis dpyi zur gnyis su e waṃ ma yā las me tog bdug pa mar me dri chab kyi khyung*/ brang*/ sog dbrag sum mdo/ lte ba'i lkog tu hūm̐ swa hrīḥ a las gnod sbyin gshin rje klu dri za 'dul byed kyi khyung bzhi/ kha sna bshang gci'i bu gar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i khyung*/ lus kyi gnas thams cad du s+t+waṃ dze ya a las sprul pa yang sprul sum sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i khyung dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lcang lo can nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs bstim/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang gi lha/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ snying ga'i rdo rje'i khyung gi snying gar hūm̐ sngon po'i mthar sngags kyi 'phreng ba gsal btab ste/ sngags ni badz+ra kro dha khyung kar khyung kar badz+ra ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le khroṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sku oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūm̐ srog tshig nan rbad lus dul nā ga mā ra ya raṃ raṃ raṃ raṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la zhi zhi rdul bun rbad phaṭ/ gsung*/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ga ru ḍa mā ra ya mā ra ya s+pho ṭa ya spo ṭa ya/ badz+ra bha ti ga ru ḍa/ be ge hūm̐ dza dza ri dza pri dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ thugs kyi sngags te/ drag byed thams cad rlag par byed// klu rnams snying khrag 'byin pa yin// zhes so// bsnyen pa'i rtags ni/ nam mkhar 'phur dang rgya mtsho skam// klu rnams za dang gsod pa dang*// gnas khang rin chen 'bar bas khengs// khyung chen zhal mthong me tog 'thu// nam mkha' bya yis khengs pa dang*// rig pa'i yi ge'i sprul pa yis/ khams gsum khyab par gnas pa la// gsang ba'i byang chub brnyes pa yin// mthun pa'i rdzas ni/ thod pa'i nang du sbrul la sogs pa'i sha la gtor ma byas/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros khyung la phog de las khyung gi sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ bdag la gnod byed kyi klu la sogs pa rang dbang med par bkug oṃ badz+ra shrī ma ma nā ga sa bhā ta tshogs khug pa la dri/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgra la byed na nā ga'i tshab tu ming ngo*// gtor ma la bstim/ de khyung la/ oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā his phul/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol lo// rnam lnga rol mos mchod/ bstod pa ni/ khams gsum sems can thams cad la// mi ma yin gyis 'tshe byed pa// 'joms phyir khyung chen skur sprul nas// 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// bsnyen pa myur bar 'dod na khyung nyid la bdag bskyed bya'o// bsad par 'dod na drag po'i sa la brub khung gzugs brnyan byas la/

brub khung 'di nyid bh+rūṃ las gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom/ las kyi gshin rje'i btson khang ngams nag pa/ gting dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du sleb pa/ 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba/ zhe sdang gi me dpung 'bar ba/ gti mug gi mun pa rab tu gtibs pa/ nga rgyal gyi brag ri gtams pa/ phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshub pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bab pa/ dug dang nad kyi na bun 'thibs pa/ de'i nang du phuḥlas gnod byed kyi klu'am dgra/ sngo la rid pa shin tu nyam thag pa/ gan rkyal du 'gyel ba/ mig shi mig tu blta ba/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa zhig tu gyur/ thugs ka nas sgo ba'i khyung bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun/ khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtum po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rnal 'byor pa bdag la snga dgra lag la bdar zhing phyi dgra yid la sems pa da dgra dngos su byed pa'i gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra'am/ gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad skad cig yud cig la dmigs pa'i nya'u 'di la lcags kyu can rnams kyis khug cig zhags pa can rnams kyis chings shig lcags sgrog can rnams kyis sdoms shig dril bu can rnams kyis mnyes shig ces gdon dgug pa'i sngags mang du bzla/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gi sgra bsgrags pas// stong gsum 'brug sgra ldi ri ri// phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ kyi sgra bsgrags pas// srid gsum thams cad 'u ru ru// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gi sgra bsgrags pas// ri bo bsgyel zhing rgya mtsho 'khrug /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gi sgra bsgrags pas// bar snang thog dang ser bas khengs// rdo rje'i mun ltar 'thibs kyin byon// rdo rje skar ltar 'khrug cing byon// rdo rje thog ltar 'bebs kyin byon// rdo rje rlung ltar 'tshub kyin byon// hūm̐/

dam tshig gzhung bzhin bsrung tsa na// thugs dam bskul lo lha yi tshogs// nam mkha'i dbyings su dmag dpung chos// bar snang khams su ru dar phyor// 'dzam bu gling du dmag dpung bkye// rdo rje'i go cha gyon la byon// rdo rje'i mtshon cha thogs la byon// dpal gyi ru dar phyor la byon// hūm̐/ rdo rje'i gshog g.yas nam mkhar gdengs// rdo rje'i gshog g.yon sa gzhir rdeb// rdo rje'i sder mos snying nas gzung*// sha khrag rus pa zhal du gsol// zhes khyung dang dregs pa thams cad bskul khug rtags byung nas/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa bha dhā ni mud ga ra kī la ya/ ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ chu shing g.yas pas brdab par bya// g.yon pas seng ldeng phur ba brdab// thun brabs pas bsad/ de nas drag po'i gtor mar byas la dbul/ lhag ma chu bor dor ro// bzlog pa ni/ de yang brub khung lcags mkhar gru gsum nag po de'i nang du gnod byed kyi klu sogs bskyed la/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le badz+ra duṣ+ṭa/ nā ga trig nan/ phuḥ hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya phaṭ ces bzla dus rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros khyung la phog de'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i bya khyung g.yas spu gri g.yon lcags kyu'i rtse la dzaḥdamar po yod pa bsnams pa/ rlung dang 'grogs te shangs g.yas kyi sgo nas 'thon/ gnod byed kyi sna g.yon nas zhugs/ snying dkar nag mtshams nas spu gris bcad/ de snying nang gi phuḥ ljang khu lcags kyu'i rtse mo'i dzaḥdamar pos blangs nas sna bug g.yas nas 'thon nas phuḥde gnod byed kyi liṅga la bstim/ so so'i ming dregs pa spyi srog tri/ sde brgyad la/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ dregs pa bco brgyad gzhan du 'gyur ba bzhin/ dgra yin na nri'o// tshur la zhugs pa dang de'i rang bzhin gyi lus de sol sdong bsgyel ba ltar 'gyel bar gyur pa'i rang bzhin/

byin rlabs bsrung ba'i nus pa/ gnas gsum gyi yig 'brur gsal ba de rang gi gnas gsum du bstim/ dgra la mdun bskyed de'i thugs ka dang bshang sgo nas bya khyung 'phros/ kho'i lha srungs rnams gnam gyi mtha' la bdas/ bya spu rlung gis gtor ba bzhin bskrad/ ma ma trag mā ra ya/ phye trag rak+ṣa ru dra mā ra ya/ dgra bo lha srungs zhes brgya tsam bzla'o// de nas dgra bo'i rnam shes sam nri de thun 'debs dus mar me rlung gis phog pa ltar nag skam skam song ba'i mthar/ thun rdzas dregs pa bco brgyad du song bas dgra bo'i srog dbugs sha khrag rus pa haṃ zas su byas par bsam mo// de ltar rdo rje gtum po khyung gi sham bu can gyi cho ga dregs pa las 'khol zhes bya ba pad+ma dkar pos gron kā ru brag tu sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig// / cho ga 'di la dogs pa dpyad par bya ste/ kha cig bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyan la/ gsang bstan rang las/ dbu rgyan la sogs rin chen ldan// dang*/ nag po sbrul lus klu chen brgyad// sku rgyan stag gi pags pa dkris// chos gos sngon pos stod dkris te// zhes pa las ma byung*/ 'khor khams gsum rnam rgyal la khro bo'i rgyan ldan zhes gsungs pa dang*/ mgon po la thod 'phreng ldan zhes gsungs pa/ yum la yum rkyang gi bsgrub par/ thod pa skam po'i 'phreng bas brgyan zhes 'byung ba/ yum dang 'khor de dag la thob/ gtso bo la min no snyam mod/ gsang bstan rang du ma bshad kyang*/ der ma bshad pa bshad pa'i rgyud las rtogs dgos pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud du/ de ltar gtso bor bye brag kyang*// gnas kyi khyad par gsum yin te// rgyan gyi khyad par thal ba'o// rigs kyi khyad par grub pa'i rigs// phyag dang zhabs sogs khyad par gyis// gtso bo 'khor las khyad par 'phags// zhes 'khor gyi rgyan las gzhan mtshungs la thal chen lhag par bshad pas shes par bya'o// 'khor yang le'u lnga par/

khyad par gyi 'khor bzhi bshad nas/ sgo mtshams lha yi rang bzhin la// zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs pas/ le'u bdun par/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi 'khor ji lta bu lags/ zhes dogs pa zhus pas/ sku yi 'khor ni khro bo bcu// rigs lnga'i ngo bo sku gsung thugs// mi 'gyur gdug pa 'dul ba yin// zhes pas sku gsung thugs 'phrin las kyi lha bzhir bsdus pa la bshad/ thugs kyi 'khor ni rigs brgya ste/ mdor bsdus sprul pa'i khro bo bzhi// zhes khyad par gyi 'khor ba'i rigs bsdus la'o// rig rkyang la dam pa rigs brgya la sogs pa bshad/ gsung gi 'khor ni dpag med kyang*/ rigs drug 'dul ba'i khyung chen yin// zhes klu rigs drug kyang dug rigs kyis phye bas bzhir bsdus te khyung bzhi bsgom par bshad pa yin la/ bzang po mdor bsdus su sgo ba bzhi dang*/ me tog ma la sogs pa bstod tshig gcig byung ba ni phyis kha che'i dpe la bcug yul dbus kyi dpe la med/ sgrub thabs rgyas par yang 'khor ma bshad pa ni rigs bsdus pa'am so so ba'i dkyil 'khor gang 'dod pa la khyab byed du 'jug par dgongs pa bzhin bzang po mdor bsdus kyang ngo*// kho bo'i rje btsun gyis mdzad pa khyung nyer gcig ma lta bu gsung gi rigs kyi dbang du mdzad pa/ sku'i rigs kyang khro bo bcus bskor dang*/ thugs kyi rigs la dregs pa 'jig rten mchod bstod la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'o// yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum po// lhar byas zhes pa'ang*/ rgyud gzhan las/ mtho ris mi yul sa 'og rnams// skad cig la ni sku gcig 'gyur// zhes pa'i lung dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis sbyar ba dang skye mched byin rlabs 'dra bas ma dpyad la/ dpa' gcig la/ khro bo yig 'bru bskyed/ 'di bde khros las/ khro bo rigs lnga rnam dag pas// go cha bgos par gyur pa na// bdud kyis nges par mi brdzi ste/

dpa' bo nyes pa ma lus 'joms// zhes 'byung ba dang*/ sprul pa dpag med phyogs bcur 'gyed// ces pa/ zla rgyan las/ rang gi lus la sprul pa yi// las sgrub khro bo sna tshogs pa// me 'od dang ni gnyis med par// gdug pa 'dul phyir spro bar bya// zhes 'byung bas/ le'u lnga par/ lus ngag sems la/ zhes pa/ yi ge yi/ lha yi mtshan ma gdab par bya// zhes pas go cha dang*// skye mched lhar byas skye mched dang*// ting nge 'dzin gyis/ nus pa mi shigs lhar byas la// zhes pas ye shes sems dpa'/ yi ge lnga 'dus/ yi ge zhes pas ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bskyed pa bstan to// go cha'i lha khyung gis byed pa ni bshad rgyud gser mig 'khyil bar bshad do// dpa' bo klu rnams 'dul don du// phyi nang skye mched thams cad kyang*// khyung gi 'phro 'dus dbang chen 'dul// zhes sogs kyis so/// / maṅga laṃ/// /
